messages:
incident-bot: Incident opened: eu-decode-paging-surge | severity: high | channel #eng-oncall | TS 4123479000
oncall-sam: getting paged for eu-decode-paging-surge. p95/p99 drifting up across eu region, seeing partial streaming frames and reconnects. tagging eng-runtime + eng-sre.
eng-runtime-zoe: joining. any recent kernel/compile changes landed to eu decode fleet?
deploy-bot: Rollout log: TRT 8.2.0 + flashattn-v3 deployed to eu-decode pool at 4123477200. Canary passed basic perf smoke but not long-tail streaming tests.
eng-sre-maya: quick metrics: p95 decode from 520ms -> 1.8s, p99 from 1.0s -> 6.1s in last 15m. Streaming partial-frame errors +300%. Device free memory trending low on several hosts.
eng-ml-ken: profiling: flashattn-v3 allocates larger per-invocation scratch (warp tiled algorithm) and introduces additional device-side barriers. CUDA profiler shows spikes in temporary allocation and D2H sync latency.
oncall-sam: customers: two paid accounts reported interrupted streaming sessions and reconnect loops; ops notified account managers.
infra-lucas: affected hosts tagged flashattn-v3: eu-decode-05, eu-decode-09, eu-decode-11, eu-decode-18. eu-decode-11 has the highest p99 and page-fault counters.
eng-runtime-ivan: immediate mitigation suggestion: 1) hot-disable flashattn-v3 kernel on affected pools, 2) reduce per-GPU concurrent decode streams, 3) temporarily increase kv-cache hotset size to avoid eviction storms, 4) prepare rollback to TRT 7.4.x if not improving.
oncall-sam: prioritize hot-disable + concurrency reduction. Maya/infra, can you run hot-disable?
infra-lucas: running hot-disable now:
```
./kernel-hotpatch --pool eu-decode --action disable --kernel flashattn_v3
```
eng-sre-maya: hot-disable returned OK on eu-decode-05,09,18. eu-decode-11 agent timed out, draining it. migrating sessions off eu-decode-11.
eng-runtime-zoe: lowering concurrency on eu-decode pool:
```
redwoodctl pools update eu-decode --max-concurrency 8
```
eng-ml-ken: also recommend toggling out the aggressive compile flags added in latest build: removed -march=native and -flto on decode targets to avoid codegen that increases scratch.
infra-lucas: applying compile flag fallback:
```
compilectl set --target decode-workers --unset flags "-march=native,-flto"
```
eng-sre-maya: telemetry after 7m: global p95 down to 900ms, p99 down to 2.9s. streaming partial-frame rate dropped ~55%. eu-decode-11 still in drain and contributing to tail.
product-ops-anya: drafting customer update: "We've detected degraded streaming performance in EU due to a recent runtime kernel update. We're applying mitigations and expect improvement shortly. No data loss. We'll update every 15 minutes." Approve?
customer-impact-jules: approve. sending to affected accounts now.
eng-ml-ken: trace samples show decode tasks waiting on device barrier inside flashattn when multiple independent sessions co-run; combined with larger scratch this amplified tail behavior.
eng-runtime-zoe: long term we should gate kernel rollouts with a "concurrent-scratch" metric and an e2e streaming tail test with varying sequence lengths.
oncall-sam: agreed. set stabilization threshold: global p99 < 2s sustained for 30m. If not hit, perform full rollback to TRT 7.4.2 for eu-decode.
incident-bot: Pager policy: if p99 > 2s persists beyond 20m, escalate to ENG-ML oncall.
eng-sre-maya: 15m update: p95 640ms, p99 1.95s global. streaming partial frames down 72% from peak. no new customer reconnect reports in last 9m.
eng-runtime-ivan: good. keep hot-disable in place, restore compiler flags only after confirming build baseline. Also add an emergency hotpatch runbook note for kernel disable steps.
eng-ml-ken: postmortem notes: flashattn-v3 increases per-invocation workspace; under mixed-length multi-tenant traffic this causes working set expansion -> KV eviction cascade -> D2H sync waits -> decode tail spikes. aggressive compile flags exacerbated the effect.
infra-lucas: preparing rollback manifest for TRT 7.4.2 but holding until we miss stabilization window. estimated rollback time for eu region ~30m staged.
product-ops-anya: sending follow-up message to customers: mitigations applied, metrics improving, monitoring continues.
eng-sre-maya: 30m check: global p95 580ms, p99 1.6s. streaming stalls nearly back to baseline. Drained host eu-decode-11 cleaned and offline for analysis.
oncall-sam: OK, hold hot-disable for now and pause further flashattn rollouts. Create tasks for rollout gate, compile-flag policy, and streaming smoke tests.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: eu-decode-paging-surge | resolved_by: eng-sre-maya | duration: 47m | TS_CLOSE: 4123479360
eng-runtime-zoe: filing follow-ups: RFC for rollout gating with scratch metrics, CI smoke job for streaming tails, compile-flag whitelist for production builds.
product-ops-anya: thanks all. closing thread; will re-open if regressions reappear.
